looks.name: Santa
looks.notes: White to the crown · red coat · black belt with a gold buckle on every face · red coat · white trim · red pants · white boot tops.

looks.name: Santa's Hat
looks.notes: The whole tree is the hat: red, a fluffy white brim at the ground ring and a white pompom at the crown; the fur sparkles.

looks.name: Frosty
looks.notes: Black hat with a red band at the crown · face with coal eyes and a carrot nose on every face · red scarf · coal buttons.

looks.name: Rudolph
looks.notes: Gold antlers branching at the crown · brown coat · tan band · a red nose on every face, the only thing that pulses.

looks.name: Snowfall
looks.notes: White flakes on night blue, falling.

looks.name: Snowflakes
looks.notes: Six-armed flakes, three to a face, on bright blue; they twinkle.

looks.name: Gifts
looks.notes: Four parcels, one to a face, in red, green, blue and gold; a ribbon cross and a bow on each.

looks.name: Candy Cane
looks.notes: Red and white spiralling down the cone, turning.

looks.name: Peppermint
looks.notes: A peppermint pinwheel on every face between green bands, turning the other way.

looks.name: Holly
looks.notes: Holly sprigs, two to a face, with red berries that twinkle.

looks.name: Bells
looks.notes: A pair of gold bells under a red bow on every face, on green; they pulse like a ring.

looks.name: Stars
looks.notes: Gold and white stars on night blue, a big star at the crown on every face; they twinkle.

looks.name: Menorah
looks.notes: A nine-branched menorah on every face, white on blue, the shamash raised; only the flames flicker.

looks.name: Star of David
looks.notes: A blue Star of David on white on every face, between two blue bands, breathing slowly.

looks.name: Kinara
looks.notes: A kinara on every face: three red candles, the black one in the centre, three green; only the flames flicker.

looks.name: Kwanzaa Bands
looks.notes: Red over black over green, rising slowly.

looks.name: Peace
looks.notes: A white peace sign on every face, on blue, breathing slowly.

looks.name: Plaid
looks.notes: Red tartan with green bands, dark threads and a gold line.

looks.name: Bows
looks.notes: A red ribbon around the tree, tied in a bow with a gold knot on every face.

looks.name: Gingerbread
looks.notes: Brown with white icing zigzags and gumdrops in red and green.

looks.name: Ornaments
looks.notes: Baubles in red, gold, blue, silver and purple on deep green; they twinkle.

looks.name: Garland
looks.notes: Gold swags in three tiers, a red bead where each swag meets the next.

looks.name: Classic Tree
looks.notes: Multicoloured lights on deep green, a gold star at the crown on every face; they twinkle.

looks.name: Joy
looks.notes: JOY in white on red on every face, between gold bands.

looks.name: Northern Lights
looks.notes: Curtains of teal, green and violet in the upper tree, drifting around it.

looks.name: Yule Fire
looks.notes: Flames climbing from the ground ring with gold sparks above, rising.
